top_signals.title: Oil Tankers Make Fortunes During War as Sinokor Dominates
top_signals.summary: The world’s oil supertankers are making unprecedented sums sailing from the Persian Gulf as Iran keeps attacking ships — with one South Korean shipowner in particular profiting from the situation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Warsh’s Pledge Sinks Two-Year Bonds: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders sent stocks higher as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s vow to bring inflation under control bolstered investor confidence after a recent rout in longer-dated Treasuries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ministers to boost innovation in payments with new objective for Bank of England
top_signals.summary: The Government intends to give the Bank of England a new responsibility to support innovation in payment systems and emerging forms of digital money, whilst continuing to prioritise financial stability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Opening address by Commissioner Šuica on the "Current Issues in the European Union and the Priorities of the Republic of Croatia” at the Conference of Ambassadors, Consuls General, Consuls and Military Attachés of the Republic of Croatia
top_signals.summary:
European Commission Govor Zagreb, 25 Aug 2026 Poštovane ekscelencije, dame i gospodo,
